notes.title: Current Suggested Tip Added (Based on Basic Strategy or Advanced Deviation)
notes.content:
Good Afternoon.

[u]Updates:[/u]

Mini 'Tip' window added which shows the suggested: Basic Strategy and/or Adv. Deviation -when available!

The Tip window is also Toggleable, so you can always minimize it, and based on your playstyle, draw your own conclusion first, then check on the Tip Window :)

-I also included insurance to the 'Advanced Deviation Wall Chart' -illuminates when available (as per the others).

- Tidied coding to the 'Basic Strategy Wall Chart' -namely the 'If Splittable' (at the base), these will all now illuminate -when avail.

-Susat

notes.title: New 'KO' System | Tutorial PC Improvements | UI Overhaul | + Insurance.
notes.content:
Game mode: 'KO' (Knock Out) Added!! -in addition to the Default Hi-Lo System.
	- Not utilizing a True Count, + only requiring a Running Count.

Insurance (bets) Added.
Projector: Updated UI. Showing Current Game Mode.
Main PC: Updated UI. Select Game Mode.

Room Rearranged. Reduced Visual Hues (Less vibrant surrounds).
Introduced a Main Light slider (Higher values are now achievable).
Help Screen: Updated Content, + included data/info. on the i) Hi-Lo & ii) KO systems.

(Trophies are still a WIP ! -Watch this space)

 - Susat.

notes.title: Hotfix - Code (Backend)
notes.content:
Quickfix : Thank you for pointing out (User: JK).

Single deck games (more likely) would seem to provide 'odd' true counts (based on the cards being dealt). The card deal had an error when trying to pull the last index (deck of cards), due to a (silly) error on my part. 

Code is now corrected + will pull on cards as intended.

Apologies.

-Sus

notes.title: Blackjack Card Counting : 101 - Touch Screen Help/Intro. (19.02.22)
notes.content:
Introduced a Blackjack 101 touch screen PC -Based on recent feedback.

This offers further explanation on how to count cards (the basics), along with examples, and short sequence examples (to help better explain!).

- Sus

notes.title: Music Player + Mini-Update (24.01.22)
notes.content:
Existing Models: Streamlined, to ease game loading times (still working on this, but the bulk is configured/sorted!).
Updated Code to Session Stats.
Introduced a; (Basic) Music Player (Next to Trophies Vending Machine). Will cycle songs in the genres: 

- Chill Playlist 
- EDM Chill Playlist 
- Jazz Chill Playlist
(Or just random Mix)

'F' to Sit, Set to Invisible whilst using Music/Interaction.

Volume (adjustable) is independent of game sound(s).

(Feedback on if I should include more tracks etc. would be appreciated! Otherwise, I'll keep slowly adding -within reason).

- Sus.

notes.title: Update - Session Monitor | Statistics' (23.01.22)
notes.content:
Hi all,

- Introduced a Session Monitor (Providing Stat.'s).
	> This will allow access to the current LIVE game data (details below).
	> It will also allow access to the past 25 Sessions Played.

Details Stored:

1) Rounds Won/Lost (+Ratio).
2) Starting & End of Session $ (+Ratio).

(Only after the alteration of Player's funds; data is then stored to the collection of previous games).

I'll be improving the code for this over the next few updates.

- Sus.

notes.title: Quick Patch (17.01.22)
notes.content:
- Player is now able to Double-down with an Ace + 'Other' Card. i.e Ace + a 5 (= a 16 or a 6), 
Doubling (with the Ace) reduces the total count by 10 and issues one final card.

- Dealer is now limited/capped at a 100k (max.) Balance (Easier enabling the 
player to; eventually, beat the Dealer).

- Small visual update to the surrounds of Basic Strategy, Adv. Deviations, 
& the True Count Tend Line.

- Flip the Dealer off: 'Thumb Mouse Button' or 'G'.

- Projector Zoom Level: + or - to Zoom.

notes.title: The 'Simulator 2100' arrives @ Jester Street
notes.content:
Run hundreds, if not thousands of hands of Blackjack, in but a moment... or two.

The Simulator uses Basic Strategy, as default, with the option to include; Advanced Deviations. 

Other options include;

[list]
[*] Custom Bets for Various True Counts (-1 to +17).

[*] Player Starting Funds
[*] Quantity of Decks.
[*] Quantity of Hands (Per Hour).
[*] Hours to be Played.
[*] Shuffle Point (Deck Penetration).

[/list]

Best of luck, Players.
